title: Apple TV to Stream Female 'F1 Academy' Races in U.S. Starting in 2027
content:
Apple today announced that all-female F1 ACADEMY races and qualifying sessions will be streamed exclusively on Apple TV in the U.S. starting in March 2027, further expanding the existing five-year partnership between Apple and Formula 1. F1 content is included with an Apple TV subscription at no additional cost.
